Which behavior should the workspace-switch filter policy apply when the report view changes workspaces?
A) clear all filters - every switch starts the report view unfiltered
B) preserve all active filters - the current filters carry into the next workspace
C) restore each workspace's last filters - each workspace reopens with the filters it had when you left it
Recommendation: B - it matches the workspace-change handler's current behavior, so the resolver at settings/resolver.ts:12 can own the policy without new per-workspace filter state or a change for existing users.
